title: Is my dream MallWorld?
content: I'm 30, born in 95 and have always wondered about my dreams since i was a child. I never really dream much but since i could remember when i do it's *always* this same weird place. But it's not just one place if that makes sense? One moment it's in a mall(walking through the hallways), next moment a theme park (solely stuck on a beat up roller coaster i can't get off of), and next a motel, a motel but built inside.. not a hotel where its back to back doors down a long hallway..like a motel but when you walk out the door its a window looking out to the outside of nothing(almost feels like where i stay in the dream, like a home, but can't go no where except my room and "hallways").. but they are all connected. Like hallways but in a blink of an eye. And I'm always anxiously looking for something but i have no idea what I'm looking for. I always see shadow figures lurk from the darkness of corners but when i turn to see it disappears, but I'm not afraid of them. And i never see people or animals, I'm rarely ever with someone, if i am it's my older brother i rarely talk to. I see the dream and myself like a movie camera sees the actor, but i can't \*see\* myself, my face is blurry.. but i know its me. And I'm always aware of everything around me, anxious almost. Could this be Mallworld? I never heard of this before. when i seen a reel about it, it actually scared me. Because of how many other people have the same or almost same dream. The comment section said reddit is full of stories and they weren't wrong! I have had alot of paranormal/weird stuff happen to me ever since i was a kid but i didn't know dreams could be linked too. I wonder why people have these similar dreams? I get them probably 7x a year maybe more. Anyway thank you for listening. Just mostly wanted to share my story and i feel a bit of relief that others have had this and I'm not alone. Sorry if my english is poorly it is not my first. If i remember anything else i will update.
